- Delays in adopting new technologies, automation or process innovations may affect operational efficiency and competitive positioning.
- Disruptions in geopolitical conditions, trade policies or other cross-border regulatory measures may influence market access, export competitiveness and demand patterns, affecting revenue visibility and procurement costs.
